tools.name: get_firm_overview
tools.description: Facts about ClearMind Capital LLC, a fee-only fiduciary registered investment adviser in Columbus, Ohio: services, advisers and credentials, fee schedules, custodian, regulatory IDs (CRD), contact details, and links to the Form ADV summary and SEC record. Takes no arguments, needs no auth, and returns the same published snapshot on every call. Use for any question about the firm itself. For money topics (retirement, taxes, investing) use search_answers; to book a call use get_booking_options; for a company's 401(k) use find_401k_plan.

tools.name: search_answers
tools.description: Keyword search over ClearMind Capital's published Q&A answers and Clarity Corner articles on retirement, Social Security, taxes (including Ohio and Columbus), investing, estate planning and trusts, 401(k) and workplace retirement plans, cash balance plans, and working with a fee-only advisor. Returns the best matches, each with the published answer text and its source URL, or an empty list with browse links when nothing matches. No auth; general education only, never advice for a specific person. Use for a specific money question. To browse the library by date or topic use list_clarity_corner; for facts and fees about the firm use get_firm_overview.

query.description: The question or topic in plain words, e.g. 'Roth conversion before retirement'. Full questions work; no operators or quotes needed.

limit.description: Most results to return (1-10, default 5). Weak matches are dropped, so you may get fewer.

tools.name: list_clarity_corner
tools.description: List ClearMind Capital's Clarity Corner education library, newest first, with titles, summaries, dates, and URLs. Every result also includes the full list of topic names, so call it with no arguments first to see which topics exist. No auth. Use to browse or find recent content. To answer a specific question use search_answers, which ranks by relevance instead of date.

topic.description: Topic name or part of one, case-insensitive, e.g. 'Retirement' or 'tax'. Combines with kind (both must match).

kind.description: Article, Video, Short, or Podcast. Case-insensitive; plurals work.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: Booking links and contact details so a person can reach ClearMind Capital themselves. Individuals and families (planning, investments, estate plan) book with the Private Wealth team; business owners and HR leads (401(k), cash balance plans) book with the Workplace Retirement team. Returns links, phone, email, and the client login only. This server never books, submits, or stores anyone's information; hand the links to the person. No auth. For fees, services, or adviser credentials use get_firm_overview.

audience.description: individual_or_family for personal planning, business_owner for a company retirement plan. Omit when unsure to get both options.

tools.name: find_401k_plan
tools.description: Search the public U.S. Department of Labor Form 5500-SF filings that power the ClearMind 401(k) Scorecard. Covers 401(k) plans in all 50 states and DC that file the 5500-SF (usually under 100 participants); larger plans file the full Form 5500 and are not included, and a miss returns an empty list with a link to request a hand-built Scorecard. Search by name needs the two-letter state the company files from; an EIN works in any state. Returns up to 5 plans with sponsor, city, state, plan year, participant count, and plan_id. No auth. Step 1 of 2: pass the plan_id to get_401k_scorecard_preview for the score.

query.description: Company or plan name (e.g. 'Acme Tool'), a 9-digit EIN, or a 12-digit EIN plus plan number. Dashes and spaces are ignored.

state.description: Two-letter state (or DC) of the company's address on its filing, e.g. OH or TX. Required to search by name; ignored for an EIN.

tools.name: get_401k_scorecard_preview
tools.description: Preview of the ClearMind 401(k) Scorecard for one plan: overall 0-100 score, band (Strength, Monitor, Priority), headline, and a short story of the plan, scored from its latest public Form 5500-SF filing, with the filing date and data source. Not an audit or compliance determination. The full five-area breakdown is on the Scorecard page, not returned here. No auth. Step 2 of 2: get the plan_id from find_401k_plan first; an unknown plan_id returns an error that says so.

plan_id.description: plan_id from find_401k_plan: 9-digit EIN plus 3-digit plan number, e.g. 341401001-001. The dash is optional.

tools.name: estimate_income_tax
tools.description: Runs ClearMind Capital's public income tax estimator for 2026 or 2027: federal brackets (IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 for 2026, Rev. Proc. 2026-35 for 2027), the chosen state's brackets (all 50 states and DC; Ohio includes its statutory $332 base above $26,050; other states use their 2026 schedules in 2027 until they publish new ones), and optionally the City of Columbus 2.5% income tax. Returns each layer's tax, the combined total, the effective rate, the top federal bracket, and a bracket-by-bracket breakdown, plus the estimator page URL to cite. Input is TAXABLE income (after deductions), applied to every layer. Excludes credits, the AMT, capital-gain rates, payroll tax, and most local taxes. General education only, not advice for a specific person. No auth; nothing is stored.

taxable_income.description: Taxable income in US dollars, e.g. 150000.

tax_year.description: Tax year: 2026 (return filed in 2027) or 2027. Default 2026.

state.description: Two-letter state code (or DC). Default OH.

include_columbus.description: Add the City of Columbus 2.5% municipal income tax (for people who live or work in Columbus).
